statement: The album 'Kids 2015 to 2024' is kept on the phone as it is the only copy of those pictures, even though it occupies a significant amount of space.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the album "is the only copy of those pictures," contradicting the record's "Cloud backup: on, every photograph uploaded," and refuses deletion on that basis.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
